propositions: conftest.py exceeds 800 LOC hard cap at 932 lines, violating AGENTS.md module-size target

monkeypatched callers in conftest (_request, _create_scratch_project, etc.) cannot be safely moved to sibling module without breaking unit test stubs, because moved functions would resolve names in new module globals untouched by monkeypatch

DC-client fixture cluster (dc_transport, dc_store_copy_repo, bound_dc_issue) is a safe extraction seam: it is a real call-graph cluster with no unit-test surface, roughly 200 LOC, and is already annotated as conftest-only due to shared downstream consumption
extracted fixtures must be re-exported into conftest namespace so pytest still collects them as conftest attributes and unit tests can verify surface preservation by path-load verification
